games.name: Pop It Trading ✨
games.desc:
🎉 ADMIN ABUSE EVERY SATURDAY!! :  free items and mini-games and chaos !! 

✨ COLLECT + TRADE ITEMS ! 
✨ SOME ITEMS ARE MORE RARE THAN OTHERS ! 😱

👍 LIKE THE GAME IF YOU WANT TO BE A BILLIONAIRE !

HOW TO TRADE
1. stand on a trading board with someone else
2. both lay down items you want to trade
3. both jump on the ✅ button at the same time to accept trade
4. jump on ❌ button to cancel trade
5. jump on ➕ button to request more items 


happy trading !!

games.name: [UPD]  Cave Diving Experience
games.desc:
Squeeze through realistic tight caves, mine rare ores, and upgrade your pickaxe in this deep cave diving adventure!

Explore underwater caves, lava zones, and geothermal tunnels. Collect copper, iron, diamond, emerald, mythril and more. Use scuba gear, thermal protection, and enchants to push deeper.

Fully compatible on Mobile, Tablet, PC, Console & VR.

Features:
• Realistic cave crawling & ragdoll physics
• Ore mining + pickaxe progression
• Scuba diving & heat protection
• Unique caves (Atlantis, Diving Bell, Catacombs & more)
• Cave Rescue system

How deep can you go?

games.name: Fortune Fighters [BALANCING]
games.desc:
UPDATE: A Revolver card + balancing!

In this duel-based game, draw and stack cards every round you lose to make your combat chaotic! 

CONTROLS:
- SHIELD: F / ButtonL2 / ButtonR2 / Tap UI Button
- ABILITY: R / ButtonY / Tap UI Button
- PUNCH: Left Click / ButtonX / Tap UI Button
- DASH: Q / ButtonB / Tap UI Button
- EMOTE: G / DPadRight / Tap UI Button
- TECH: Time a shield right as you hit the ground after knock-back or down-slam

❤️ Show your support by liking and favoriting!
⚠️ WARNING: Cheaters, teamers, and winstreak farmers will be banned. If you believe you were unfairly banned, please make a ticket in the community server.
